# Key-Value Store JavaScript API

Everything the [Key-Value Store](/docs/extensions/kv) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](/docs/reference/go).

## $kv

The app's key-value store (ext/kv, the kv/v1 contract): named JSON values kept without a collection or a migration,
in PocketBase's _params, so they ride along in backups. Names are 1 to 128 characters: letters, digits and
_ - . : / , starting with a letter or digit; start yours with a prefix of your own ("myapp/settings"). Values are any
JSON up to 1 MiB. Every call is local and sync.

### $kv.get()

```ts
$kv.get(name: string): any
```

The value stored under a name, parsed from its JSON.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the value's name, such as "myapp/settings" |

Returns `any`: the value, or null when the name has none.

```js
const settings = $kv.get("myapp/settings") ?? { theme: "light" }
```

Go: [`kvv1.Get`](/docs/reference/go/kv/v1#get).

### $kv.set()

```ts
$kv.set(name: string, value: any): void
```

Stores a value under a name, replacing any value it had.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the value's name, such as "myapp/settings" |
| `value` | `any` | anything JSON.stringify takes, up to 1 MiB as JSON |

```js
$kv.set("myapp/settings", { theme: "dark", lastRun: new Date().toISOString() })
```

Go: [`kvv1.Set`](/docs/reference/go/kv/v1#set).

### $kv.delete()

```ts
$kv.delete(name: string): void
```

Removes a name's value. Removing a name with no value isn't an error.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the value's name |

```js
$kv.delete("myapp/settings")
```

Go: [`kvv1.Delete`](/docs/reference/go/kv/v1#delete).

### $kv.list()

```ts
$kv.list(prefix?: string): KvEntry[]
```

The values whose names start with a prefix, sorted by name.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | `string` (optional) | the start every name shares, such as "myapp/"; omit it for every value |

Returns `KvEntry[]`.

```js
for (const e of $kv.list("myapp/")) console.log(e.name, e.updated)
```

Go: [`kvv1.List`](/docs/reference/go/kv/v1#list).

## Types

### KvEntry

One value in the app's key-value store.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Its name. |
| `value` | `any` | The value, parsed from its JSON. |
| `created` | `string` | When it was first stored (ISO 8601, UTC). |
| `updated` | `string` | When it last changed (ISO 8601, UTC). |

Go: [`kvv1.Entry`](/docs/reference/go/kv/v1#entry).
